hook_with_zero_step: hook with zero step to overlap ZeroRedundancyOptimizer step with DDP backward pass where optimizer computation begins after the last gradient bucket
hook_with_zero_step_interleaved: hook with zero step interleaved to overlap ZeroRedundancyOptimizer step with DDP backward pass where optimizer computation interleaves with backward computation
perform_local_step: perform a local optimizer step using gradients provided by a DDP gradient bucket with ZeroRedundancyOptimizer
broadcast_bucket: broadcast a bucket's parameters across assigned ranks in a distributed training group
save_ddp_bucket_info: save DDP gradient bucket information for ZeroRedundancyOptimizer to use when overlapping optimizer and backward passes
